references.label: captive ball
references.description: Shoot the captive ball or bash boat one extra time to light boosts.

references.label: center ramp
references.description: Use the harpoon lane, left orbit, or center ramp to raise the fin; hit it to attach one barrel, then shoot a flashing feed to start Jaws Multiball 1.

references.label: Chum bucket target
references.description: The chum bucket sits in the left-center playfield and advances chum lines.

references.label: Shark fin target
references.description: The fin rises from the center-right playfield and completes many encounter and bounty awards.

references.label: Harpoon lane
references.description: The narrow harpoon lane is beside the mini-flipper in the upper-right area.

references.label: left bank
references.description: Machete: Complete the left bank while Light Machete is active.

references.label: left outlane
references.description: Wait until the ball enters the left outlane.

references.label: left spinner
references.description: Start Beach Panic at the wave ramp or Night Swim at the left spinner.

references.label: left standup
references.description: Complete the left standup bank to light Machete at an inlane.

references.label: Fishing reel spinner
references.description: The fishing reel is the lower-center spinner and Mako start shot.

references.label: Right ramp and Gear collect
references.description: The right ramp collects Gear and starts selected bounties.

references.label: right-outlane
references.description: Give one small nudge while the ball is above the right-outlane post.

references.label: Wave ramp
references.description: The wave ramp is the major left-side ramp used to start and finish Beach Panic.
